Three recent WDAY stop-outs (all losers) reinforce the need to wait for true basing confirmation before re-entering high-volatility names. No existing positions require SELL action at this time.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $215.00 or better on any intraday pullback toward SMA50 (~$206). Do not chase if price surges above $222 before fill.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: TE Connectivity is a high-quality industrial connector company with direct exposure to AI data center buildout, EV adoption, and defense modernization — three durable secular tailwinds. PEG of 0.94 is the lowest among quality candidates, fwd P/E 16.7x on 13.8% revenue growth represents genuine value. FCF of $2.3B is well-covered, D/E 43 is conservative for the sector, and EPS revisions are trending up +2.1%. TECHNICAL: Price is in confirmed UPTREND (basing), sitting at just 38% of its 52-week range — well within Stage 1-to-2 transition territory. Only +4.1% above SMA50, so entry is not extended. SMA50 slope is flat (+0.1%), meaning the base is still forming rather than running away. ATR-based stop at 1.5x gives a clean 5.7% risk buffer below a meaningful support zone. Next earnings 82 days out removes near-term binary event risk. Position sized at ~92 shares = ~$19,787, within the $19,874 headroom constraint.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) price closes below $202.82 stop on a daily basis; (2) revenue growth decelerates materially below 10% at next earnings report (thesis break); (3) stock rallies to $258 target (~52w high zone) and shows distribution/reversal signals; (4) macro shift causes industrial/capex cycle to reverse; (5) time stop — reassess if no meaningful progress after 90 days. If position moves +10%, raise stop to breakeven to protect capital.
